Section 1.  Tenant’s Insurance.  Tenant shall maintain, at its sole cost and expense, throughout the Term: (a) commercial general liability insurance with limits of not less than $1,000,000 per occurrence and $3,000,000

in the aggregate, naming Landlord as an additional insured; (b) professional/medical malpractice liability insurance with limits of not less than $1,000,000 per occurrence and $3,000,000 in the aggregate; and (c) property insurance covering Tenant’s personal property, medical equipment, and improvements at replacement cost. Tenant shall deliver a certificate of insurance evidencing such coverage to Landlord prior to the Commencement Date.

aggregate; (b) umbrella or excess liability insurance of not less than $5,000,000 following form over commercial general liability, automobile, and employer’s liability coverage; (c) professional and medical malpractice liability insurance of not less than $1,000,000 per claim and $3,000,000 aggregate, with tail coverage after termination if written on a claims-made basis; (d) property insurance at full replacement cost covering Tenant’s improvements, clinical build-out, personal property, and medical equipment; (e) workers’ compensation at statutory limits and employer’s liability insurance; (f) business interruption and extra-expense coverage sufficient to fund at least twelve (12) months of rent; and (g) pollution or environmental liability insurance if Tenant handles regulated medical waste, hazardous drugs, or radiologic materials. 6.2 Content Delivery Schedule. Licensor shall deliver Puzzles in batches of not less than thirty (30) at a time, on a rolling basis, to ensure uninterrupted daily availability. Each batch is subject to Publisher's prior written approval before publication. Publisher shall use commercially reasonable efforts to review and respond to each submitted batch within ten (10) business days of receipt. If Publisher has not provided written approval or rejection within such ten (10) business day period, Licensor shall deliver written notice of non-response to Publisher (a "Reminder Notice"). Publisher shall have three (3) additional business days from receipt of the Reminder Notice to provide written approval or rejection. If Publisher fails to respond within such three (3) business day period, the applicable batch shall not be deemed approved and Licensor may not proceed with publication. For clarity, if Publisher does not approve a submitted batch within the timeframes set forth above, Licensor may continue to use and publish Puzzles from any previously approved batch to ensure uninterrupted daily availability of the Licensed Digital Format.
